text:
Marta (Marketing Ops): Hey team — marketing needs a verified bench sweep to finalize the launch post. Requirements: coldstart heatmap (0–30s window granularity), 50/90/95/99 percentiles for generation, per-request token cost, and a one-row delta vs fp16. Please run a quantized variant and fp16 in us-west1 and attach a small reproducible payload bundle we can link to in the blog.

Elena - Growth: To add: include a 10% random sample of long-context prompts (6k tokens) in the payload pack and tag each job with marketing/launch-2026 so we can find it later. Also want a short quality check — pairwise embedding-sim on 500 examples.

Sam (Eng Runtime): OK. A few clarifying Qs:
- exact model names? we have redwood-13b-q8 and redwood-13b-fp16-prod; which should we use?
- load profile: steady QPS or bursty? how long should each run be?
- caching: do you want prefix caching on for fp16 and disabled for quant, or both disabled for parity?

Marta (Marketing Ops): Use redwood-13b-q8 for quant and redwood-13b-fp16-prod for baseline. Profile: 40 QPS steady for 12 minutes, with a 90-second ramp and a cold probe every 2 minutes (30s of zero-traffic then resume) to build the heatmap. Cache: disable for quant run, enable normal prefix cache for fp16. Include the embedding-sim check Elena mentioned.

Priya (Data Science): I'll provide the eval set: "launch-eval-500-v1" — 500 pairs, balanced across short, medium, and long prompts. We'll compute cosine similarity on embeddings and a token-level divergence metric. Please surface any >3% drop in embedding-sim as a quality flag.

Sam (Eng Runtime): Sounds good. We'll tag runs: marketing-launch-quantq8 and marketing-launch-fp16. We'll also record traces and coldstart histograms per instance. Example payload (we'll ingest the full marketing-payloads-v4.json from the shared drive):

```
[
  {"id":"m1","prompt":"Summarize Redwood's new inference offering in one short paragraph.","max_tokens":80},
  {"id":"m2","prompt":"List 6 ways to reduce per-token cost when serving LLMs.","max_tokens":140},
  {"id":"m3-long","prompt":"<context 6000 tokens> Describe cache impacts across warmup phases.","max_tokens":300}
]
```

bench-bot: Job queued: job_id=mk-qlaunch-3423-17, ETA ~1.5h. Artifacts: https://internal-artifacts.redwood/mk-qlaunch-3423-17. Notifying #eng-runtime :robot_face:

Sam (Eng Runtime): Note two infra constraints: q8 builds are only available on our p4d farm in us-west1; if capacity is low the job may fallback to fp16 earlier — we'll post a capacity warning in the run log. Also we'll produce both raw percentiles and cost-normalized curves (tokens/sec and USD per 1k tokens).

Marta (Marketing Ops): Timeline check — can we get a draft 1-line claim + preliminary percentiles within 24 hours of run start? We need to update the launch draft.

Sam (Eng Runtime): If run starts within the hour we can push preliminary numbers and a headline in ~16 hours, full artifact pack + eval summary in ~30–36 hours. If that timing works say :thumbsup: and we'll lock.

Elena - Growth: :thumbsup: Lock it. Please make the headline include the measured cost savings per 1k tokens and call out any embedding-sim regression >3% as "needs review". Thanks everyone — we'll pull artifacts once bench-bot posts the final link.
